messages.author: 9bb8c7eb3016ed27
messages.subject: Presenting ggmcmc
parts:
Dear all,

We have another ggplot2 creature with us. Let me present you ggmcmc, an R
package for visual MCMC convergence and diagnostics, which tries to make
life easier by plotting all convergence plots in a single pdf file for a
more convenient inspection.

ggmcmc is a set of tools for assessing and diagnosing convergence
of Markov Chain Monte Carlo simulations, as well as for graphically display
results from full MCMC analysis:
http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ggmcmc/index.html

There is a tutorial showing the possibilities of ggmcmc at
http://xavier-fim.net/packages/ggmcmc

It is still under development and I am plannig it to extend it, so it would
be great if you can test it and tell me whether it is useful or not, or any
other idea that you want to share.
https://github.com/xfim/ggmcmc

Best,
--
- Xavier -
